title: Patterns that matter
summary: Strategy, observer, state, factory/registry, adapter and decorator: the pain each solves, the idiomatic Go form, how each breaks, and when a pattern is over-engineering.

labs.title: Fee engine: func-type strategies, marginal tiers, runtime registration, strategy called outside the lock
Event bus: re-entrant sync callbacks, panic containment, channel subscriptions that never block or double-close
Transfer lifecycle: transition table with guards, duplicate vs illegal events, atomic Apply
Provider registry: fail-closed lookup, constructors outside the lock, startup Build that reports every bad tenant
Two vendor APIs behind one port: integer money, error taxonomy, fail-closed mapping, shared contract suite
Vendor client decorators: Chain, retry, circuit breaker (single probe), timeout, logging, order tests

outcomes.text: Choose between a switch, a function parameter, a map of funcs and an interface for varying behaviour, and say when the answer flips.
Implement a strategy-based fee engine in integer minor units with correct rounding, runtime replacement and a call path that holds no lock.

Implement an observer bus with synchronous callbacks and channel subscriptions that survives re-entrant, slow, panicking and racing subscribers, and explain when an in-process observer is the wrong tool for audit.
Model a transfer lifecycle as a transition table with guards, distinguish duplicate from illegal events, and test it exhaustively and under concurrency.
Build a provider registry that fails closed, validates every tenant at startup, and explain init() order and forgotten-import bugs.
Write vendor adapters behind one domain port with a classified error taxonomy that keeps the cause, fail-closed mapping and a shared contract test suite.
Compose retry, circuit-breaker, timeout and logging decorators and predict the effect of their order, including retry amplification.
Judge when a pattern is over-engineering, and narrate a minimal design plus a mid-way requirement change in an LLD round without reciting pattern names.
Port the registry to generics and build net/http middleware and RoundTripper chains.
